Loss of consciousness and postural tone as a result of diminished cerebral blood
flow. This can result from
Vaso-vagal attack or cardiac causes; prolonged standing; severe emotional
disturbance; sight of blood (e.g. witnessed by medical student for the first time
in theatre)
The more severe form is associated with various heart diseases:
Arrhythmias (especially complete heart block); Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy;
'Heart attack' (myocardial infarction); Atrial myxoma; Aortic stenosis;
Dissecting aneurysm other causes; Pulmonary embolism; Vertebro-basilar
insufficiency; Subclavian steal syndrome; Carotid sinus pressure and rarely
Migraine headache
